newsitem.title: SPAIN: MCI/BT deal compatible with Unisource-Telefonica.
newsitem.headline: MCI/BT deal compatible with Unisource-Telefonica.

text.p: A spokesman for Telefonica de Espana told Reuters on Friday its deal with MCI /British Telecom was compatible with its presence in Unisource.
"We believe the deal with MCI/BT is compatible with (our) presence in Unisource," Telefonica spokesman Alberto Martinez told Reuters.

Telefonica Chairman Juan Villalonga was quoted in a statement from BT earlier, saying: "We are initiating steps to withdraw from Unisource. I have informed our current partners of this intention and have begun discussions on the conclusion of our arrangement."

But Martinez later disputed the wording of the joint news release issued by BT. "That is a lie," Martinez said, referring to the statement that Telefonica was starting to back out of the Unisource agreement.
Martinez said it might have been a problem of wording.
"It's a question of wording," Martinez said.
Villalonga earlier told Reuters the deal with MCI/BT would not harm its deal with Unisource.
"The alliance with BT and MCI does not harm, according to legal opinions from two international law firms, the deals signed with Unisource," Villalonga said.
